events.text: CCW concluded in Geneva (in force 2 Dec 1983).
Anti-Personnel Mine Ban Convention concluded in Oslo (in force 1 Mar 1999).
UN Firearms Protocol adopted (in force 3 Jul 2005).
UN Programme of Action on small arms adopted.
Convention on Cluster Munitions concluded in Dublin (in force 1 Aug 2010).
EU Common Position 2008/944/CFSP adopted.
Arms Trade Treaty adopted in New York (in force 24 Dec 2014).
Fifth Circuit affirms denial of a preliminary injunction in Defense Distributed v. Dep't of State (3D-print files under ITAR).
FAA Reauthorization Act of 2018 enacted; § 363 bars weaponized drones without FAA authorization.
Council Decision (CFSP) 2019/1560 amends the Common Position.
W.D. Wash. sets aside the State Department's 2018 temporary USML modification and authorization letter for 3D-print files.
USML Categories I-III transfer to the EAR takes effect, incl. 15 CFR 734.7(c).
Ninth Circuit vacates the injunction against the State rule: AECA § 2778(h) bars judicial review.
ATF frame or receiver rule takes effect.
ITAR part 120 reorganization takes effect (definitions renumbered).
Updated DoD Directive 3000.09 issued.
UNGA adopts A/RES/78/241, first resolution on lethal autonomous weapons systems.
BIS interim final rule tightens firearm export licensing.
UNGA adopts A/RES/79/62.
Lithuania's withdrawal from the CCM takes effect.
Supreme Court decides Bondi v. VanDerStok (7-2): ATF rule not facially inconsistent with the GCA.
Pub. L. 119-21 sets NFA transfer tax at $0 except for machineguns and destructive devices.
US announces it will review advanced UAS exports like manned aircraft; USML targeted revisions take effect the same day.
BIS rescinds the 2024 firearms rule except the new ECCNs.
UNGA adopts A/RES/80/57 (164-6-7); the United States votes no.
Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania leave the Ottawa Convention.
Finland leaves the Ottawa Convention.
Poland leaves the Ottawa Convention.
NSPM-11 orders DoD to update Directive 3000.09 within 90 days.
N.D. Tex. reportedly holds ATF frame or receiver provisions unconstitutional (Defense Distributed v. Blanche); secondary source.
CCW GGE on LAWS adopts its 2024-2026 report by consensus, with elements of an instrument.
Commission adopts update to the EU dual-use list (Annex I, Reg. 2021/821).
